text:
Situation: Dexmedetomidine hydrochloride supply is critically low at Corvale East. The 100 mcg/mL 2 mL vials have 59 on hand (8.3 days) and the 200 mcg/50 mL bags have 45 on hand (5.4 days). Corvale General holds adequate stock across all presentations, including 159 vials of 100 mcg/mL 2 mL (20.6 days). Corvale Lakeside has 30 bags of 200 mcg/50 mL (13 days).

Why: FDA’s shortage database shows dexmedetomidine hydrochloride with a current status date of 2020-04-10. The record does not state a reason for the shortage.

Our position: Internal transfer from Corvale General can resolve the immediate gap at Corvale East without new purchasing. External suppliers are not on FDA’s shortage list today, but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants, creating sourcing uncertainty.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 41 vials of dexmedetomidine HCl 100 mcg/mL 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate Avenacy Inc. (manufacturer Hengrui Pharma) for supplemental purchase — requires buyer approval.
3. Defer purchases from Civica Inc., Medical Purchasing Solutions LLC, and Precision Dose Inc. until plant information is verified — requires buyer and pharmacy director concurrence.

Not recommended: Initiate new purchase orders from Civica Inc., Medical Purchasing Solutions LLC, or Precision Dose Inc. without confirmed manufacturing site transparency.
